defs.def: to change sth in order to make it suitable for a new use or situation 使适应，使适合（新用途、新情况）

ex.s: Adapting himself to the intense training.
ex.t: 适应高强度训练。

ex.s: To adapt to the cold weather.
ex.t: 适应寒冷天气。

ex.s: You should be able to work well in a team and adapt to an international working environment．
ex.t: 你应该能够在团队中良好协作，并适应国际化工作环境。

ex.s: People in Ethiopian highlands have adapted to living at high altitudes.
ex.t: 埃塞俄比亚高原的人们已经适应了在高海拔生活。

ex.s: Around the world, people are adapting in surprising ways, especially in some poor countries.
ex.t: 世界各地的人们正在以令人惊讶的方式适应，特别是在一些贫穷国家。

ex.s: But he is providing a few years during which the farmers will, perhaps, be able to find other means of adapting.
ex.t: 但他争取到了几年时间，农民或许能在其间找到其他的适应办法。

ex.s: But some suggestions for adapting are not.
ex.t: 但有些适应建议并非如此。

ex.s: When the polluting industries argue that we’ve lost the battle to control carbon pollution and have no choice but to adapt, it’s a nonsense designed to make the case for business as usual.
ex.t: 当污染企业辩称我们在控制碳污染上已经失败、除了适应别无选择时，那是一派胡言，目的是为一切照旧的商业模式辩护。

ex.s: Human beings will continue to adapt to the changing climate in both ordinary and astonishing ways.
ex.t: 人类将继续以普通和惊人的方式适应不断变化的气候。

ex.s: But the most sensible form of adaptation is surely to adapt our energy systems to emit less carbon pollution.
ex.t: 但最明智的适应方式无疑是调整我们的能源系统以减少碳排放。

ex.s: adapt to carbon pollutionB. plant highly profitable crops
ex.t: 适应碳污染B. 种植高利润作物

ex.s: But it’s amazing how you can adapt ____59____ learn in a new environment.
ex.t: 但令人惊讶的是，你能如何适应在新环境中____59____学到的东西。

ex.s: Adapting to new environments.
ex.t: 适应新环境。

ex.s: So even if emissions were to begin to decrease today, we would still face the challenge of adapting to climate change.
ex.t: 所以即使排放量从今天开始减少，我们仍将面临适应气候变化的挑战。

ex.s: We are therefore not talking about adapting to a new standard, but to a constantly shifting set of conditions.
ex.t: 因此我们谈论的不是去适应一个新的标准，而是去适应一组不断变化的条件。

ex.s: Farmers in many countries are also adapting like this—either by growing new produce, or by growing the same things differently.
ex.t: 许多国家的农民也在这样适应——要么种植新的农产品，要么用不同的方式种植同样的东西。

ex.s: After all, if we adapt in that way, we may avoid the need to change in so many others.
ex.t: 毕竟，如果我们以这种方式适应，也许就不需要在其他方面做出如此多的改变了。

ex.s: Adapting to climate change.
ex.t: 适应气候变化。

ex.s: What’s more, it is easy to make and can be adapted to individual tastes.
ex.t: 此外，它易于制作，可根据个人口味进行调整。

defs.def: to change your behaviour in order to deal more successfully with a new situation 适应（新情况）
to change a book or play so that it can be made into a play, film/movie, television programme, etc. 改编；改写

ex.s: Elizabeth Sims analyzes the final chapters of five great novels to see what key points they include and how you can adapt them for your work.
ex.t: 伊丽莎白·西姆斯分析了五部伟大小说的最后章节，看看它们包含哪些要点，以及你如何将其改编运用到自己的作品中。

ex.s: It is adapted by Joe McDonough, with music by David Kisor.
ex.t: 由乔·麦克唐纳改编，大卫·基索作曲。

ex.s: He is best known for his best-selling novel Jaws, which was later adapted as a film by Steven Spielberg.
ex.t: 他最出名的是他的畅销小说《大白鲨》，后来被史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格改编成电影。

ex.s: Some of his other works were also adapted for cinema, including The Deep, The Island and White Shark.Benchley later regretted writing sensationalist work about sharks, and became a strong advocate for marine conservation.
ex.t: 他的一些其他作品也被改编成电影，包括《深海》、《岛屿》和《白鲨》。本奇利后来后悔写了关于鲨鱼的耸人听闻的作品，并成为海洋保护的坚定倡导者。

ex.s: Adapted from a work by Schopenhauer One cold winter night, a group of porcupines gathered together to keep warm.
ex.t: 改编自叔本华的作品在一个寒冷的冬夜，一群豪猪聚集在一起取暖。

ex.s: In this part adapted from a chapter of the book, Aronnax describes the experience of walking on the sea bed… 1 And now, how can I look back upon the impression left upon me by that walk under the waters?
ex.t: 在本部分改编自本书的一章，阿龙纳斯描述了在海床上行走的经历…… 1现在，我如何回顾在水下行走给我留下的印象？
